visible_text: Points A, B, C and D lie on a circle with centre O. Given that ∠BAO = 28°, ∠BCD = 114° and ∠CDO = 42°, determine the measure of ∠ABC.
reasoning: Since OA = OB, triangle OAB is isosceles, so ∠OBA = ∠OAB = 28°. Similarly, OC = OD makes triangle OCD isosceles, giving ∠OCD = ∠ODC = 42°. From ∠BCD = 114° we have ∠BCO = 114° – 42° = 72°. Triangle OBC is also isosceles (OB = OC), so ∠OBC = ∠OCB = 72°. Then ∠ABC = ∠ABO + ∠OBC = 28° + 72° = 100°, which corresponds to option C.
